mapper.select: /*taskLogHandlerMapper.selectTaskExecutionList*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TASK_LOG_NO AS EXECUTION_NO /*TASK번호*/ ,EXECUTION_NAME AS EXECUTION_NAME /*수행타스크이름*/ ,EXECUTION_START_TIME AS EXECUTION_START_TIME /*수행시작일시*/ ,TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(EXECUTION_START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF'),'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS FF3') AS EXECUTION_START_TIME_FORMAT /*수행시작일시포멧*/ ,EXECUTION_END_TIME AS EXECUTION_END_TIME /*수행종료일시*/ ,TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(EXECUTION_END_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF'),'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS FF3') AS EXECUTION_END_TIME_FORMAT /*수행종료일시포멧*/ ,EXECUTION_SERVER AS EXECUTION_SERVER /*수행서버*/ ,EXECUTION_TIME AS EXECUTION_TIME /*수행시간*/ ,NVL(EXECUTION_TIME,REPLACE(REPLACE(SUBSTR(SYSTIMESTAMP(3)-TO_TIMESTAMP(EXECUTION_START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF'),12,12),':',''),'.','')) AS EXECUTION_TIME_FLOW /*수행시간흐름*/ ,EXECUTION_LOG AS EXECUTION_LOG /*수행로그*/ ,NVL(DBMS_LOB.getlength(EXECUTION_LOG),0) AS EXECUTION_LOG_SIZE /*수행로그크기*/ ,EXCEPTION_LOG AS EXCEPTION_LOG /*예외로그*/ ,NVL(DBMS_LOB.getlength(EXCEPTION_LOG),0) AS EXCEPTION_LOG_SIZE /*예외로그크기*/ ,SYS_CREATION_DATE AS SYS_CREATION_DATE /*생성일*/ ,SYS_UPDATE_DATE AS SYS_UPDATE_DATE /*수정일*/ FROM TB_TASK_EXECUTION_HISTORY WHERE TASK_LOG_NO IS NOT NULL AND TASK_LOG_NO=#{executionNo} AND EXECUTION_NAME=#{executionName} AND EXCEPTION_LOG IS NOT NULL ORDER BY EXECUTION_NO DESC ) WHERE 1=1 AND ROWNUM<=#{rownum}
